items.title: morluto/rea
items.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
items.author: morluto
items.summary_zh: morluto/rea 是一个把 agent 用在逆向工程上的 GitHub 项目，覆盖范围从 App 行为分析一路下探到 native 二进制层面。它让自动化智能体去驱动整个逆向流程，而不是只做单一的反汇编，适合安全研究、漏洞分析和需要摸清闭源程序内部逻辑的开发者。
items.summary_en: rea is a GitHub project that applies agents to reverse engineering, spanning app behaviour analysis all the way down to native binaries. Rather than being a single-purpose disassembler, it aims to let autonomous agents drive the investigation, which makes it relevant to security researchers and anyone who needs to understand closed-source software.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 作者回顾了 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 4 月使用 Cursor 的体验，认可其 Tab 补全、Cmd+K、Agent、Plan Mode，并曾全程零代码做出一个小程序。因 Cursor 转向按量计费、成本不可控，公司决定中国区改用 OpenAI Codex，他感觉 Codex 更像超级 Agent 而非 IDE。适合关注 AI 编程工具选型与成本的人。
items.summary_en: A developer recounts a year on Cursor, praising its Tab completion, Cmd+K, Agent and Plan Mode, and notes he once shipped a mini-program without writing code. In April 2026 Cursor moved from fixed licenses to usage-based billing, so his company switched its China region to OpenAI Codex. He finds Codex closer to a general-purpose super Agent than to an IDE.

items.title: 黄仁勋为微软站台：没有 Windows 就不会有英伟达，Satya 当场“讨市值”
items.summary_zh: 微软在 10 月 8 日的 Windows 发布会上宣布引入“混合智能”：通过模型路由与 Windows ML，GitHub Copilot 等产品可按任务复杂度在云端和本地模型间切换，HydraFusion 将首次直接调用运行在 Windows PC 上的本地模型。黄仁勋与 Satya Nadella 同台回顾从 Windows 95、DirectX 到 CUDA 的合作，并判断 Agent 正成为新的“电脑用户”。当天微软股价微涨约 0.1%。
items.summary_en: At its October 8 Windows event, Microsoft introduced "hybrid intelligence": model routing and Windows ML let GitHub Copilot and other products switch between cloud and local models, and GitHub Copilot's HydraFusion will call local models running on Windows PCs directly. Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella traced the partnership from Windows 95, DirectX and CUDA to Azure's InfiniBand HPC, arguing agents are becoming a new kind of computer user. Microsoft shares rose roughly 0.1% that day.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了一个不需要服务器就能托管 git 仓库的私人服务

items.summary_en: gits is a git hosting service that runs entirely on Cloudflare's serverless offerings, so it needs no server of your own, and its bundled GitHub App syncs every repository under an authorized account. It deliberately omits issues and pull requests, keeping only plain repo hosting — useful for repositories you'd rather not put on GitHub, or for backing up private ones.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 文章梳理了 2026 年技术面试的高频问题——“AI 能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你”，并指出“AI 代码质量不行”“AI 不懂业务”“总得有人做 Code Review”这三类回答已经失效。作者主张分两层作答：AI 写代码、人做决策，AI 能写一个文件、人能设计一个系统。
items.summary_en: This post examines a now-common 2026 interview question: if AI writes 80% of the code, why is the company still hiring you? It argues the stock answers — AI's code quality is poor, AI doesn't understand requirements, someone has to do code review — no longer land, and suggests answering on two levels: AI writes code while humans make decisions, and AI writes a file while humans design a system.

items.summary_en: The Claude Code team has confirmed it will support AGENTS.md, the instruction-file standard it previously refused to adopt, a stance that drew a public warning from Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke. On the Latent Space podcast, core team member Thariq Shihipar went further: as models get stronger, static instruction files like CLAUDE.md may eventually become unnecessary, so new projects can skip them until the same failure keeps recurring.

items.title: Rails 之父 DHH 狂吹 Rust 快 150 倍，被开发者翻代码后群嘲
items.summary_zh: 在 Rails World 2026 上，DHH 一边称 Rust 是“过去 40 年最丑陋的编程语言”，一边表示只要由 Agent 写代码、自己不用看，就乐于享受它的性能。他让 Agent 把 37signals 的群聊应用 Campfire 重写为 Elixir、Go 和 Rust 版本，加载聊天室页面时 Rust 达每秒 36260 个请求，约为 Rails 的 150 倍、Elixir 的 50 倍、Go 的 9.4 倍。
items.summary_en: At Rails World 2026, DHH called Rust the ugliest programming language of the past 40 years, yet said he loves it as long as agents write the code and he never has to read it. He had agents rewrite 37signals' Campfire chat app in Elixir, Go and Rust; loading a chat room page, Rust hit 36,260 requests per second, roughly 150x Rails, 50x Elixir and 9.4x Go.

items.title: [推广] Qwen Image 2.1 Pro 与 Nano Banana 2.1：透明编辑、视频参考和多轮修图怎么选？
items.summary_zh: 这篇推广对比 Qwen Image 2.1 Pro 与 Nano Banana 2.1 两款图像模型：前者最多支持 10 张参考图，主打透明素材与蒙版局部编辑，尺寸可自定义但不支持联网搜索。后者支持多轮对话修图、视频参考和 Google 搜索，最多 14 张参考图（物体 10 张、角色 4 张），输出分 1K、2K、4K 档，适合需要连续修图或引用检索内容做视觉创作的创作者。
items.summary_en: This sponsored comparison pits Qwen Image 2.1 Pro against Nano Banana 2.1 for image work: Qwen takes up to 10 reference images and focuses on transparent assets and masked local edits, with no web search, while Nano Banana 2.1 supports multi-turn conversational retouching, video references and Google search, accepts up to 14 reference images, and outputs at 1K, 2K or 4K. It's aimed at creators deciding between extracting transparent subjects, iterating on one image, or grounding visuals in search and video.

items.title: [分享创造] [开源自荐] 小喷 1.1.0： Mac 菜单栏语音伙伴，支持 ChatGPT 订阅和本机 Ollama
items.summary_zh: 小喷是作者以 Swift 6 / SwiftUI 开发的原生 macOS 菜单栏语音助手，采用 MIT 协议，喊唤醒词就能查天气、定计时器、调音量，问答可接 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容 API、ChatGPT 订阅或本机 Ollama。1.1.0 新增回声消除和开口打断，提醒与音量指令全在本机解析，适合想在键盘前顺口下指令的 Mac 用户。
items.summary_en: Xiaopeng (小喷) is a native macOS menu-bar voice assistant written in Swift 6 and SwiftUI and released under MIT; say its wake word to check weather, set timers or change volume without hunting for a chat window. Version 1.1.0 adds echo cancellation and barge-in, parses reminder and volume commands locally, and can use your own OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, a ChatGPT subscription or local Ollama. It needs macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon, and the unsigned build lacks Apple notarization.

items.title: OpenAI 只用 15 天，就杀死了估值 100 亿美元的 Jev？
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 DevDay 上发布 Decisions API，底层用当前最小、最便宜的 GPT-6 Luna，让模型从一组预设选项中做选择并返回置信度，延迟 150 毫秒，而直接调用 Luna 做同类任务需要 1.6 秒。该 API 目前仅提供限量预览，定价与单次请求支持的候选答案数量均未公布。它几乎复刻了发布仅 15 天的 Jev 的核心能力，Reddit 的 AI_Agents 版块随即出现“Jev Is Dead”的讨论。
items.summary_en: At its DevDay, OpenAI introduced a Decisions API built on GPT-6 Luna, its smallest and cheapest model, which picks from preset options and returns a confidence score. OpenAI cites 150ms latency versus 1.6 seconds for calling Luna directly on the same task. It's in limited preview with pricing and option counts undisclosed, and closely mirrors the core capability of Jev, which launched just 15 days earlier — prompting a "Jev Is Dead" thread on Reddit.

items.title: 单次RL后训练烧掉260万美元、每步37亿Token，小米披露MiMo-V2.6“规模化强化学习”路线
items.summary_zh: 小米 MiMo 团队公开 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（总参数 1.02T、激活 42B）与 Flash（310B / 15B）两个 MoE 模型，并披露一套规模化 Agentic RL 流程：每个 step 采样 1568 个 prompt、各生成 16 条 rollout，合计约 2.5 万条轨迹、27 亿至 37 亿 token。Pro 单次 RL 后训练成本约 260 万美元，用于评判 Agent 行为的 Grader 已占 12.7%，适合关注 RL 成本与奖励设计的人。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi's MiMo team published a technical report on MiMo-V2.6, releasing two sparse MoE models: Pro (1.02T total, 42B active) and Flash (310B, 15B active). Its scaled agentic RL pipeline samples 1,568 prompts per step with 16 rollouts each, roughly 25,000 trajectories and 2.7–3.7 billion tokens, using GRPO with asynchronous partial rollouts. RL post-training costs about $2.6M for Pro and $0.9M for Flash, with Grader compute at 12.7% and 14.2%.

items.title: 比 Astra 还贵！GPT-6.1 Sol 极速版上线，社区吐槽：“500 美元套餐都撑不过一天”
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 于 10 月 8 日在 Responses API 中为 9 月 29 日发布的 GPT-6.1 Sol 增加了 Ultrafast 极速档位，开发者无需更换模型名，只需把服务档位设为 ultrafast 即可调用。该档位被定位为最快的 API 服务层级，Token 单价是标准模式的 6 倍，面向对延迟敏感、愿意为速度付费的工作负载。
items.summary_en: On October 8, OpenAI added an Ultrafast service tier to GPT-6.1 Sol, the model it shipped on September 29, in the Responses API; developers keep the same model name and just set the tier to ultrafast. Positioned as its fastest API tier, it is priced at six times the standard per-token rate and targets latency-sensitive workloads willing to pay more for speed.

items.summary_en: A developer shared Nano Banana, a web tool that puts prompt entry, aspect-ratio and resolution selection and result viewing on one page. It supports 1K, 2K and 4K output plus batch generation, costing 8, 12 and 28 credits per image respectively, with the total shown before submission; sample prompts on the homepage load straight into the generator. It targets people making product shots, posters or social images.

items.title: 模型开放之后，AI能力为什么仍难以复用？
items.summary_zh: InfoQ 这篇文章讨论为什么模型开放之后 AI 能力仍难复用：模型可下载不等于系统可复现，代码公开不等于能力可直接调用，AI 项目还依赖模型权重、数据、提示词、工具接口和运行环境，底层模型或工具一变就可能让原有工作流失效。文章以 2026 年世界人工智能开源大赛（GOAI）为例——覆盖 91 个国家和地区、超 1.4 万名开发者、2999 份初赛作品、70 个项目进入总决赛——指出文档完整性、环境可复现性和接口稳定性正成为 Star 数与 Benchmark 之外的评价指标。
items.summary_en: An InfoQ article argues that open-sourcing AI models doesn't make their capabilities reusable: a downloadable model isn't a reproducible system, and AI projects depend on weights, data, prompts, tool interfaces and runtime environments, so swapping the base model or a tool can break existing workflows. It points to the 2026 Global Open-source AI competition (GOAI), which drew 91 countries and regions, over 14,000 developers and 2,999 valid entries narrowed to 70 finalists, and notes that docs, environment reproducibility and interface stability are becoming metrics beyond GitHub stars and benchmarks.

items.title: 金融监管领域的 Harness 实践：让知识与数据驱动 Agent 稳定运行
items.summary_zh: 中软融鑫总工程师于浩军 在 AICon 2026 深圳站分享了金融监管报送场景下的 Harness 实践，用知识底座、数据底座、受控状态机与全链路可追溯，把容易发散的大模型 Agent 改造成“宁可不答、不能答错”的严格受控系统。该场景对准确率要求接近 100%，远高于一般业务里 97% 就算不错的水平。适合在强监管、高合规行业落地 Agent 的团队参考。
items.summary_en: Yu Haojun, chief engineer at Zhongruan Rongxin, gave a talk at AICon 2026 Shenzhen on Harness practices in financial regulatory reporting. His approach combines knowledge and data foundations, a controlled state machine, and full-chain traceability to turn free-form agents into strictly governed systems that would rather abstain than answer wrong. The domain demands near-100% accuracy and zero tolerance for error, making it relevant to teams deploying agents in heavily regulated industries.

Terms and integration plans aren't disclosed in the provided text, so developers tracking edge runtimes and serverless platforms will have to wait for specifics.

items.title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
items.author: gmays
items.summary_zh: Whistle 是一个开源语音识别模型，体积仅 16.9 MB，跑在与 Needle 相同的 CPU 推理引擎上，支持七种语言，首个 token 延迟 11 毫秒。由于可以和 Needle 一起加载，同一个二进制文件能把音频片段直接转成 tool calls，适合在本地或边缘设备上做轻量语音交互的开发者。
items.summary_en: Whistle is an open speech recognition model that ships in just 16.9 MB and runs on the same CPU engine as Needle. It transcribes seven languages and returns its first token in 11 ms, and since it can load alongside Needle, one binary can turn a clip straight into tool calls — useful for lightweight voice interfaces on local or edge hardware.

items.title: 被吹上天的 JWT，为什么主流网站一个都不用
items.description: 打开浏览器的开发者工具，翻一翻 github.com 的 Cookie。里面只有一条 _gh_session，一串 Rails 框架加密后的会话数据。
items.summary_zh: 文章以 github.com 为例：开发者工具里只有一条 _gh_session，是一串 Rails 框架加密后的会话数据，作者借此说明主流网站为何不把状态塞进 JWT，而继续用服务端会话 Cookie。适合正在为鉴权方案选型、想知道 JWT 在真实系统里到底卡在哪里的后端开发者。
items.summary_en: Using github.com as the example, the author notes its cookies contain just a single _gh_session value — Rails-encrypted session data — to explain why mainstream sites keep state on the server rather than packing it into a JWT. It is aimed at backend developers choosing an authentication strategy and wondering where JWTs actually fall short in production.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章盘点了 2026 年最火的 10 个 AI 编程助手 Skills。它们是 Anthropic 在 2025 年 10 月推出的 Agent Skills 标准的产物——一个含 SKILL.md 的文件夹放进 ~/.claude/skills/ 后即由 AI 按需加载。作者称 100 个社区 Skill 测试中 70% 不合格，排第一的 Superpowers 拥有 20+ 子模块。
items.summary_en: A Juejin roundup of the ten most popular AI coding-assistant Skills of 2026, built on Anthropic's Agent Skills standard from October 2025, where a Skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file that Claude loads on demand from ~/.claude/skills/. The author notes 1,400+ Claude Code Skills exist on GitHub but 70% of 100 community Skills tested failed, and the top pick, Superpowers, bundles 20+ workflow submodules.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: 掘金精选：三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.summary_en: Featured on Juejin: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？

items.title: 从codex转战workbuddy使用一周的感受
items.description: 不是恰饭，也不是踩一捧一。只是记录一个 Codex 老用户切换到 WorkBuddy 的真实一周，以及过程中踩到的坑和省下的钱。 一、为什么换：被逼无奈的"搬家" 很早就听说腾讯出了智能体编程工具 W
items.summary_zh: 一位 Codex 老用户记录了自己切换到腾讯智能体编程工具 WorkBuddy 一周的真实体验，包括过程中踩到的坑和省下的钱，并强调既非恰饭也不踩一捧一。对于正在纠结 AI 编程工具选型、关心迁移成本与实际开销的开发者，这类一线对比比官方宣传更有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A long-time Codex user documents a week of switching to WorkBuddy, Tencent's agentic coding tool, covering the pitfalls hit along the way and the money saved. The write-up is explicitly not sponsored and avoids trashing either tool, which makes it worth reading for developers weighing a migration and wondering what it really costs.

items.title: 再见 Superpowers！很多 Skill 真的可以扔掉了。
items.description: 前几天在知乎看到有人问：Codex 用上 GPT-5.6 后，为什么不少人开始不用 Skills 了？ 确实，相信大家也发现，很多 Skill，尤其是开发相关的，真的慢慢就开始用不上了。 我现在看到一
items.summary_zh: 作者认为 GPT-5.6、K3、Claude Fable5 等模型变强后，许多只重复常规步骤的开发类 Skill 已无必要，Codex 现在能自己读项目、顺调用链定位问题并补测试。他还提到 Codex 的渐进式披露最多占用上下文窗口的 2%（上限 8000 字符），Skill 装多了会互相抢活，自己长期保留的不超过 20 个。
items.summary_en: With models like GPT-5.6, K3 and Claude Fable5 now able to read a project, trace call chains and add tests on their own, the author argues most development Skills that merely restate routine steps can be dropped, using Codex as his example. He also notes Codex's progressive disclosure caps Skill metadata at 2% of the context window or 8,000 characters, so too many Skills compete for attention; he keeps fewer than 20.

items.title: 为什么不推荐走Agent开发？
items.description: 大家好呀，我是飞鱼 最近有些读者在学 Agent 开发，问了我一些问题： 其实大家经常看到网上很多培训班都会说，后端要向 AI 转型： 我个人觉得，Agent 开发这个职业想要有长期发展的前提是：你的
items.summary_zh: 作者飞鱼认为 Agent 开发岗位要有长期发展，前提是所在领域本身有增量、由业务驱动，否则大部分存量岗位会在 1-2 年内被淘汰。他把 Agent 开发视为后端的一个分支，指出只靠 LangChain、LangGraph 搭个 Demo 就去面试拿高薪并不现实，985 加多段大厂经历的人也不易拿到 offer。
items.summary_en: Writing as Feiyu, the author argues Agent development roles only hold long-term value when the domain itself is growing and driven by real business demand, and predicts most existing Agent jobs will be eliminated within one to two years. He frames Agent work as a branch of backend engineering, saying that a LangChain or LangGraph demo is not enough to land a high-paying offer in today's crowded market.

items.title: boykopovar/AnyPS5
items.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
items.author: boykopovar
items.summary_zh: 工具 AnyPS5 通过 relinker 把 PS5 可执行文件转成 Linux 和 Windows 的原生格式，并实现可供动态链接的 system prx 库，不使用模拟器，也不另起运行时进程。README 显示目前只有 2D 平台游戏 Dreaming Sarah 通过验证，适合关注主机二进制重链接与系统库替代思路的开发者。
items.summary_en: AnyPS5 converts PS5 executables into Linux and Windows native format via a relinker, plus implementations of system prx libraries suited to dynamic linking, with no emulation or separate runtime process. So far the README lists just one verified title, the 2D platformer Dreaming Sarah, so it is early-stage but worth a look for anyone interested in binary relinking and replacing console system libraries.

items.title: AI 时代，最危险的不是被替代，而是努力不沉淀
items.description: 最近和身边的朋友交流，大家有一个相似的感受： 有了AI之后，现在一天能做完以前三天的活。 可问题是，老板也知道一天能做完三天的活了。以前写一个方案要半天，现在半小时就能出初稿，于是更多方案、更急
items.summary_zh: 作者观察到，用 AI 后一天能干完过去三天的活，但老板也知道这一点，于是更多更急的需求涌来；他提醒最危险的不是被替代，而是忙碌没有沉淀成职业资产。他把 AI 提效分为任务提效、流程整合、能力重构三层，认为停留第一层只会让人变成效率更高的执行者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post argues that with AI one day's work now covers three, but managers know it too, so more and more urgent tasks pile up. The author's warning: the real risk isn't being replaced, but that the extra output never accumulates into portable career assets. He splits AI use into task efficiency, process integration and capability rebuilding, and staying at the first level only makes you a faster executor.

items.title: 2026年金九银十，我面了22个前端
items.description: 金九银十的前端面试 九月是传统的招聘旺季，我们团队扩编，我参与了前端岗位的全部技术面。HR初筛后到我手里的有三十来份简历，前前后后面了二十二场，最后发了 3 个 offer，入职了 2 位。面完之后挺
items.summary_zh: 一位前端面试官复盘了 2026 年金九银十的招聘：团队扩编期间经手三十多份简历、面了 22 场技术面，最终只发出 3 个 offer、2 人入职。素材只给出这段开头，后续的面试题与候选人评价未提供，适合正在准备前端面试或参与招聘的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: A front-end interviewer recaps the 2026 autumn hiring season: with the team expanding, they worked through more than 30 résumés and ran 22 technical interviews, ending with 3 offers and 2 actual hires. Only that opening is available in the source, so the interview questions and candidate assessments that follow aren't included; relevant to developers preparing for front-end interviews or running hiring loops.

items.title: storytold/artcraft
items.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
items.author: storytold
items.summary_zh: ArtCraft 是 GitHub 仓库 storytold/artcraft 的项目，官方定位为面向艺术家、设计师和电影人的 crafting engine，并自称“The IDE for artists”，README 附有两分钟 YouTube 演示视频和 Discord、X、LinkedIn 等社区入口。它尝试用 IDE 的形态承载创作流程，适合关注创意工具设计的开发者。
items.summary_en: ArtCraft, hosted in the GitHub repo storytold/artcraft, describes itself as a crafting engine for artists, designers and filmmakers and brands itself 'The IDE for artists'. Its README links a two-minute demo on YouTube plus Discord, X and LinkedIn channels. The pitch is an IDE-style environment for creative work, which makes it relevant to anyone tracking how authoring tools for visual media are being designed.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
items.author: cathrynlavery
items.summary_zh: cathrynlavery/diagram-design 是一个 agent skill，把图表输出为单文件、自包含的 HTML + SVG 并套用你自己的品牌样式，覆盖 44 种图表类型，支持 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Factory Droid 和 Pi。它明确去掉阴影，也不用 Mermaid 那套默认样式。适合要把图表嵌进文档、又嫌现有生成效果太模板化的人。
items.summary_en: cathrynlavery/diagram-design is an agent skill that renders diagrams as a single self-contained HTML + SVG file in your own brand, covering 44 diagram types and supporting Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid and Pi. It deliberately drops shadows and avoids what the author calls Mermaid slop. Aimed at developers who need diagrams inside docs but find existing generators too templated.

items.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
items.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
items.author: bilawalsidhu
items.summary_zh: God's Eye View 是一个在浏览器里运行的间谍卫星模拟器，用真实公开数据在写实 3D 地球上叠加飞机、船只、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等实时图层，并支持实时 AI agent 驱动的免手语音控制。项目来自播放量超 500 万的 YouTube 系列（原名 WorldView），曾登上 GitHub Trending 第一，适合做地理空间可视化的人参考。
items.summary_en: God's Eye View is a browser-based spy-satellite simulator that layers live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public camera feeds onto a photorealistic 3D globe, all from real open-source data, with hands-free voice control driven by a realtime AI agent. It comes from the viral YouTube series (formerly WorldView) with 5M+ views and reached #1 on GitHub Trending.

items.title: chrislgarry/Apollo-11
items.description: Original Apollo 11 Guidance Computer (AGC) source code for the command and lunar modules.
items.author: chrislgarry
items.summary_zh: chrislgarry/Apollo-11 收录了阿波罗 11 号指令舱与登月舱制导计算机（AGC）的原始源代码，README 还被翻译成简体中文、日语、俄语等几十种语言。想读真实航天汇编代码、了解 1960 年代软件工程做法的人可以直接翻看。
items.summary_en: chrislgarry/Apollo-11 collects the original Apollo 11 Guidance Computer (AGC) source code for the command and lunar modules, and its README has been translated into dozens of languages including Chinese, Japanese, Russian and Hindi. It is a rare chance to read real 1960s flight-software assembly code, useful for anyone curious about early software engineering and spaceflight history.

items.title: lyogavin/airllm
items.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
items.author: lyogavin
items.summary_zh: AirLLM 通过大幅降低显存占用，让 70B 大模型在单张 4GB GPU 上运行，且无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝。按 README，它还能在 4GB 以内跑 2.8T 的 Kimi K3、6GB 跑 125B 的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、约 12GB 跑 671B 的 DeepSeek-V3，并新增了小显存训练支持。适合显卡有限又想本地跑大模型的开发者。

items.title: AI 都会写代码了，还要不要学传统编程了? （强烈建议阅读）
items.description: AI时代是否还需学编程？狂师指出：非技术人重在“会用”——懂基础概念、能说清需求、会简单验收；技术人则必须“会判”——语法基础不能丢，但重心转向读懂AI代码、判断质量与风险。写交给AI，责任留给人。
items.summary_zh: 作者狂师讨论 AI 能写代码后是否还该学编程：非技术人重在“会用”，懂基础概念、能说清需求、会简单验收；技术人必须“会判”，语法基础不丢，但重心转向读懂 AI 代码、判断质量与风险。结论是把写交给 AI、把责任留给人，适合正犹豫是否继续投入学编程的开发者。
items.summary_en: Author Kuangshi examines whether programming is still worth learning now that AI writes code: non-technical people should focus on using it well — grasping basic concepts, stating requirements clearly, doing light acceptance checks — while engineers must keep judging, retaining syntax fundamentals but shifting effort to reading AI-generated code and assessing its quality and risk. Writing goes to AI; accountability stays with humans.
